shops.name: Corner Stall
shops.tagline: Everyday homeware, bags and gadgets from a small market stall

products.title: White Ceramic Mug with Red Leaf Design and Blue Rim
products.summary: White ceramic mug with a red leaf motif and blue rim.
products.description: A white ceramic mug featuring a red, three-leaf plant design on the side and a blue rim. The mug has a standard curved handle and a glossy finish.

products.title: Blue Fabric Utility Bag with White Webbing Handles
products.summary: Blue fabric utility bag with white webbing handles.
products.description: A medium-sized blue fabric bag featuring two white webbing handles. The bag has a soft, unstructured body with visible stitching along the seams and a slightly shiny, synthetic surface.

products.title: Faceted Clear Glass Tumbler
products.summary: A tall, faceted clear glass tumbler with a geometric design.
products.description: A tall, clear glass tumbler featuring a faceted, geometric design with vertical ridges and a distinct angular base. The glass is transparent with a smooth rim and a sturdy, multi-sided profile.

products.title: Foldable Desk Stand for Phone or Tablet
products.summary: Black adjustable stand that props up a phone or small tablet, with a ribbed grip pad.
products.description: A black foldable desk stand with a flat base, a hinged arm and a ribbed rubber pad that holds a phone or small tablet at an adjustable angle. Pre-owned, with light wear on the base.
